description: This file defines a class SuppressExceptions for handling error suppression in PDF processing, along with experimental error handling interfaces and structs that are currently not in use.

classes.name: SuppressExceptions
classes.description: Handles optional error suppression without exceptions, tracking if an error occurred.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Sets ErrorOccurred to true if suppressExceptions is not null; otherwise invokes throwException.

methods.name: HasError
methods.description: Returns true if suppressExceptions is set and its ErrorOccurred is true.
